items.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
items.description: Denmark and Greenland have welcomed the deal, which Trump claims will give the US "permanent control over security and all other needs" in the Danish territory.

items.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
items.description: The US president has had a tense and fiery relationship with the US media throughout his political career.

items.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
items.description: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

items.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
items.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

items.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
items.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

items.title: Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named
items.description: Greg O'Neill "loved the ocean", his family say, as police boats and helicopters patrol Perth's beaches in search of his body and the shark that attacked him.

items.title: Millions without power as Cuba hit by latest major blackout
items.description: Widespread power outages have become increasingly common due to fuel shortages made worse by a US blockade.
